Supermarket chains in at least seven European countries have said the temperatures of refrigerators and freezers in some of their shops soared overnight to as high as 50C (122F), echoing a cyber-attack
a.title: Shop fridges and freezers across Europe hit by fresh suspected cyber-attack

b.title: Hackers disrupt refrigeration systems at European supermarkets
